summary: Recent updates in 2D graphics for the Firefox browser have introduced some important changes. The property **font-stretch** has been renamed to **font-width**, while maintaining the old name as an alias. This change helps clarify its purpose and improves consistency within web design practices. Additionally, Firefox can now query HDR (High Dynamic Range) display information, which means users will have better insight into their display capabilities when viewing media content, enhancing the overall visual experience for those with advanced screens.
